transcript.speaker: Radio advertisement
transcript.text: Do you like to learn about unusual vacation destinations? Then don't miss Radio Explorers with host Bruce Mac Williams. Each week Bruce Mac Williams gives detailed information about exotic locations, interviews leading environmentalists, and offers special tips from experienced tour guides. Radio Explorers is broadcast every Tuesday at 3 P.M., with a repeat show at 9 P.M. on Wednesday. For a complete schedule of upcoming destinations that will be discussed, visit our Website at radioexplorers.org.

questions.explanation: The advertisement promotes Radio Explorers, a weekly broadcast.
Bruce Mac Williams is introduced as the host of Radio Explorers.

questions.explanation: The speaker tells listeners to visit the Web site for a complete schedule.

transcript.text: Do you look forward to long business trips? Vella customers do, because they know they'll find a Vella hotel wherever they go. transcript.speaker: Automotive product advertisement
transcript.text: People might love summer, but cars don't. During the summer, an annoying yellow dust called pollen begins appearing in the air, and everywhere else. Everyone is familiar with the thick layers of pollen that cover streets, buildings, and cars in the summer. However, many people don't realize that pollen can damage your vehicle's paint. If pollen is left on a car's paint for too long, it will leave a permanent stain. Sure, rain will wash the pollen off of a car, but you can't count on that. Use Wilkinson Brand Wax Sealer to reliably protect your car's paint from pollen. Stop by your automotive supply dealer today and ask for the brand America trusts, Wilkinson.
